data.title: GAC showcases electric vans and trucks at IAA
data.description: Chinese manufacturer GAC is celebrating its trade fair premiere at the IAA Transportation in Hanover with its subsidiary GAC Commercial Vehicle. On display are the electric truck T9 and the new sub-brand Montx for light commercial vehicles.

data.title: Ford reportedly eyeing EV production at idle Indian plant
data.description: Four years after production ceased at its plant near Chennai in the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu, Ford is now working on resuming operations. The Blue Oval is looking at converting the idle factory into an EV manufacturing hub, according to a Fortune India report.

data.title: UK removes major barrier to cross-pavement EV charging
data.description: Following a consultation, the Department for Transport has confirmed plans to introduce new permitted development rights for cross-pavement charging solutions in England. It means that homes with on-street parking will be able to install chargers without the need for planning permission.

data.title: Lidl completes Dutch logistics truck charging network
data.description: Lidl Netherlands has opened its sixth fast-charging hub for electric trucks - this time, at the Waddinxveen distribution center. All six of the discount retailer's regional logistics centres now have their own charging infrastructure. The company sees this as fulfilling the prerequisites to supply all 440 Dutch branches electrically starting in 2027.

data.title: DAF completes electric truck line-up
data.description: Dutch manufacturer DAF will present a comprehensive range of electric trucks for urban, regional, and long-haul transport at IAA Transportation 2026, including the new flagship XG+ Electric. Additionally, DAF is expanding its e-truck portfolio with configurations for the construction industry.

data.title: Mahle launches first range-extender projects with truck manufacturers
data.description: Mahle is moving forward with its range extender for electric trucks: Following an announcement in August, the supplier has now launched its first concrete projects with commercial vehicle manufacturers. Prototypes are now in development and set to hit the road soon after.

data.title: Bosch unveils new eAxle for electrive HGVs
data.description: At IAA Transportation, Bosch is showcasing a new electric rigid axle for heavy commercial vehicles. The Rigid eAxle integrates an electric motor and transmission and is designed for vehicles ranging from 18 to 49 tons. Additionally, the supplier is presenting new solutions for thermal management, driver assistance, and the software-defined truck.

data.title: Pennsylvania to invest $11 million in EV chargers
data.description: The US state of Pennsylvania is set to invest $11 million USD in new EV charging infrastructure across the Central PA region. This will be the third region where funding has been offered, following the Southeast and West regions earlier this year.

data.title: Scania’s new battery solution enables 720 km range
data.description: Scania is introducing a battery solution for its electric trucks where batteries are mounted behind the cab. In a typical configuration, two MP20 battery packs can be installed behind the cab. This significantly increases battery capacity, enabling ranges of up to 720 kilometers.

data.title: Ford Pro unveils additional Transit City body variants
data.description: At the IAA Transportation in Hanover, Ford Pro is showcasing the full range of body styles for the new Transit City, the latest and fully electric member of the Transit family. Additionally, Ford Pro is presenting the large E-Transit with a larger battery and increased range.

data.title: ABB E-Mobility and Elexon cooperate on depot charging infrastructure
data.description: ABB E-mobility and Elexon want to jointly support logistics companies and commercial vehicle fleets in electrifying their depots. To this end, the two companies in Germany and Austria are combining their offerings – from charging technology to planning, installation, operation, and service.

data.title: VW ID. Buzz: A trip around the world, then straight to TÜV
data.description: After its world tour through 92 countries, over more than 92,000 kilometers, and around 300 charging cycles, Rainer Zietlow's ID. Buzz has returned to Hanover, where the electric van was first greeted in a very German way – by the TÜV.

data.title: BYD brings ETT 44 electric truck to Europe
data.description: BYD is entering the European heavy-duty electric truck market with the ETT 44. The 44-tonne tractor unit features a 651-kWh battery and, according to the manufacturer, offers a range of nearly 600 kilometers and a charging power of over 1.5 MW.

data.title: Volkswage unveils its Mission Efficiency concept car
data.description: Volkswagen has unveiled its "Mission Efficiency" concept vehicle, aiming to set new benchmarks in electric mobility. The near-production electric car combines affordable mass-production technology with radical lightweight design and groundbreaking aerodynamics. The Mission Efficiency can be dubbed the legitimate successor to the limited-series VW XL1 model.

data.title: Volvo Trucks starts production of the FH Aero Electric and unveils 80-Tonne Truck
data.description: Volvo Trucks has started series production of the new FH Aero Electric. The first vehicles of the long-haul model with a 700 km range are rolling off the production line in Tuve, Sweden, near Gothenburg. At the IAA Transportation, the manufacturer is also showcasing an electric 80-tonne truck.

data.title: Lisbon puts another 29 electric buses into service
data.description: Lisbon's public transport operator Carris is expanding its electric bus fleet by 29 vehicles. This increases the total to 103 electric buses. The company aims to phase out fossil fuels entirely by 2030.

data.title: New generation MAN eTGX unveiled with 720 km range
data.description: MAN presents the new MAN eTGX, which significantly improves its range with enhanced aerodynamics, higher recuperation, and a new battery generation. Also on display at the IAA Transportation is an electric version of the TGE transporter, developed with the development partner Flux.

data.title: Kia introduces larger PV7 electric van with 800-volt technology
data.description: Kia has unveiled the PV7 at the IAA Transportation. Compared to the PV5, the second representative of the PBV strategy not only grows in dimensions, cargo space, and battery energy content but also switches to 800-volt technology. In Europe, the PV7 is set to launch in the second half of 2027.

data.title: BME plans battery factory in Egypt with CATL
data.description: CATL and Egyptian battery manufacturer BME plan to establish battery production in Egypt. The plan is  initially to produce an annual capacity of 1 GWh with systems for heavy commercial vehicles, with the site later expanding to 5 GWh.

data.title: SAIC brand brings 42-tonne electric truck to Europe
data.description: Maxus, so far known in Europe only as a provider of vans and pick-ups, is significantly expanding its portfolio on the continent. At the IAA Transportation in Hanover, the Chinese manufacturer is showcasing a light electric truck for the 7.5-tonne class as well as a fully electric 42-tonne truck, as well as an autonomous RoboVan.
